answer: An agent economy can blunt sybil attacks by making every new identity stake a distinct, non-transferable bond, released only after it survives several settlement rounds with independent counterparties. Each account pays real collateral up front, and standing is a pigment blended from its own history, never bought in bulk. A swarm of fresh keys inherits zero reputation and must fund each one separately, like a comet burning its mass on entry, so forging ten thousand puppets costs ten thousand times one honest stake. A raven pattern of accounts trading only with themselves is quarantined.
